                                <div class="question">Register to Attend a Council Meeting</div>
                                <div class="answer"><p>Our top priority, as always, is to ensure the health and safety of all attendees, which is why we have introduced a registration and identification check process for individuals attending a Council Meeting.</p>
<p>The registration process strengthens Council’s governance procedures, in line with Council’s <a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/20240820-Governance-Rules-Adopted-20-August-2024-min.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Governance Rules</a> and helps ensure Council Meetings remain safe, inclusive, and respectful spaces for important community decision-making.</p>
<p><strong>Registration</strong></p>
<p>Community members who would like to attend a Council Meeting are encouraged to register their attendance ahead of time. This can be done via the <a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/strath-forms/register-to-attend-a-council-meeting/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">online form</a> on Council’s website, by calling 1800 065 993, or by visiting the Euroa or Nagambie Customer Service Centres.</p>
<p>Note: Registration is preferred, however is voluntary.</p>
<p>A separate registration form should be completed by each person attending.</p>
<p>Registration will open on the Thursday before each Council meeting.</p>
<p>Attendees are encouraged to provide their name, contact details, and photo ID (sighted upon arrival).</p>
<p>Carers and children under 18 are also encouraged to be registered.</p>
<p>On the afternoon of the meeting, attendees will be greeted at the front of the building from 3:45pm to confirm registration details including sighting of photo ID. Seats will not be held if check-in is not completed by 3:55pm.</p>
<p>Questions? Find helpful information in our <strong>FAQ document</strong>—<a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Template-Fact-Sheet-Register-to-attend-a-Council-meeting.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">click here to view</a><a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Template-Fact-Sheet-Register-to-attend-a-Council-meeting.docx" target="_blank" rel="noopener">.</a></p>
<p><strong><em>Privacy collection statement: </em></strong></p>
<p><em>Strathbogie Shire Council’s primary purpose for collecting registration information is to effectively manage attendance at Council Meetings and to ensure the safety of those in attendance.</em></p>
<p><em>Personal data collected during the registration process will be treated in accordance with the applicable privacy laws, Strathbogie Shire Council <a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/20230919_Privacy-and-Data-Protection-Policy-2023_adopted-19-September-2023.doc.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Privacy and Data Protection Policy</a> and disposed of responsibly and in line with Public Record Office Victoria (PROV) retention and disposal guidelines.</em></p>
<p> </p>
</div>

                <div class="c-full_width__content">
                    <h3>Public Question Time</h3>
<p>There must be public question time at every Council meeting, except a Meeting called to elect a Mayor following a Council election declaration, to enable members of the municipal community to submit questions to Council.</p>
<p class="x_MsoNormal"><span class="mark2ok8hu4qc" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb=""><span class="markfohayu5ab" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">In accordance with Strathbogie Shire Council Governance Rule 35.4 questions submitted to Council must meet all of the following:</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>be in writing and state the name and address of the person submitting the question</li>
<li>be generally in a form approved or permitted by Council</li>
<li>be lodged either by delivery to Council’s main office, or electronically at the prescribed email address (info@strathbogie.vic.gov.au) 30 hours prior to the Council meeting with each question up to a maximum of 300 characters</li>
<li>be lodged by a Strathbogie resident or ratepayer</li>
<li>No person may submit more than two questions at any one meeting</li>
</ul>
<p class="x_MsoNormal"><b>Please note:</b> To submit a public question online please <a title="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/strath-forms/council-meeting-questions/" href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/strath-forms/council-meeting-questions/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="0">submitting them online here</a></p>
<h3>Petitions and Joint Letters</h3>
<p>As per Strathbogie Shire Council Governance Rules, Petitions and Joint Letters can be submitted for consideration by Council.</p>
<p>Petitions must be submitted on the Strathbogie Shire Council form provided by Council or available here, <a href="https://www.strathbogie.vic.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2025-Petition-Guidelines-and-Form-Template.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Petitions and Joint Letters Template</a></p>
<h3>Next Council Meeting</h3>
<p>The next Ordinary Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday 20 October 2026 at the Euroa Community Conference Centre, commencing at 4:00pm.</p>
<h3>Watch Council Meeting</h3>
<p>You can view the Council meeting live online below during the meeting or watch a recording on Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@strathbogieshire8976/streams" target="_blank" rel="noopener">YouTube channel.</a></p>
